contact.basis: Original NRCan bare-earth lawn elevation in front of the Centre Block and Peace Tower entrance. Individual building floor heights are approximate.

verticalDatum: Vertical elevations from Natural Resources Canada’s HRDEM Mosaic digital terrain model

sources.dataset: Natural Resources Canada HRDEM Mosaic DTM

method: The original WCS raster is sampled bilinearly inside the signed local frame at 2.875 metre steps, without grading or filling.
limitations: The original WCS source represents the existing bare earth. Courtyard finished grade and individual foundation levels remain approximate.
The bounded provider response is preserved byte for byte. The review heightmap resamples the same data in the placement frame.
